title: Completing the Wantzel-Galois Constructibility Proof — OQ extension (01)

problemStatement.plain: Prove the Wantzel-Galois characterization (`wantzel_galois_iff`): a complex number alpha is constructible (in the parent's inductive `IsConstructible` sense) if and only if the Galois group of the splitting field of its minimal polynomial over Q has order a power of 2. The parent slug closes the three classical impossibility results via a weaker degree criterion; this OQ-01 extension targets the abstract characterization (or, more modestly, the forward direction `constructible -> Gal is 2-group`).
whyMatters: Closes the most prominent 'out-of-scope' entry in the parent file's docstring (~500 LOC was the parent's estimate; the forward direction is ~200 LOC).
Exercises and consolidates the Galois infrastructure already built in the parent (`isConstructible_map`, `isConstructible_minpoly_pow2`, `isConstructible_irred_degree_pow2`).

Bridges to sibling slugs (`angle-trisection-oq-02-oq-04-oq-01`, `angle-trisection-cos-20-gal-oq-01-*`) which use explicit QuadraticTower or Galois-cardinality formulations of the same characterization.

proven: Parent: isConstructible_map (Galois invariance under Q-AlgHom C -> C)
Parent: isConstructible_minpoly_pow2 (minpoly Q alpha has natDeg = 2^m)
Parent: isConstructible_irred_degree_pow2 (irreducible p with constructible root has natDeg = 2^m)
Parent: angle_trisection_impossible_degree, doubling_cube_impossible_degree, regular_7gon_construction_impossible (the three classical impossibility theorems, all proved via degree criterion alone)
open: Reverse direction (constructible_of_galois_two_group): full FTGT + Sylow + degree-2 extension as sqrt adjoin — likely spin off to oq-02 slug
knownResults.goal: Prove `wantzel_galois_iff` or at minimum its forward direction (`isConstructible_galois_two_group`).
